verdict.seen: The first frame shows an empty pit, then a dark inclined belt with dots appears running up between the lower floor and the upper floor.
A box sits on the steep belt and moves down toward the bottom across the frames, with a SLIDING label.
Yellow flat steps appear along the belt, tilted with the slope, and are bolted on across the frames.
Steps sit on the belt and a TILTED label shows, but the box is barely visible at the bottom and no clear slide-off is seen.
verdict.problem: Show the box clearly on a tilted step and sliding off down the slope; make the box larger and more visible.

verdict.seen: Red and blue tracks appear along the slope and the steps look level on them in the later frames.
A yellow rectangle outline sits in the room above the escalator, not tracing the escalator itself.
verdict.problem: Move the outline to enclose the escalator on the slope instead of the empty room area.

verdict.seen: Yellow arrows appear at the top gear and the level steps move up the slope, with the gear at the top visible.
The steps are on the tracks and a ROLLING BACK label appears, but the steps show little visible movement down and the gear stopping is unclear.
verdict.problem: Show the steps clearly rolling down toward the bottom and the gear stopped, with loaded steps visible.

verdict.seen: The escalator with steps and tracks is visible, but no red brake sliding into the gear can be seen and nothing appears to change across the frames.
verdict.problem: Show a red brake clearly sliding into the gear at the top and the steps stopping.

verdict.seen: A black handrail and a ceiling lamp appear, but the lamp hangs in the room with no visible ceiling and the handrail is thin.
verdict.problem: Attach the light to a visible ceiling and make the handrail thicker and anchored on the escalator.

verdict.seen: The camera pulls back to show the whole house with the escalator build in the cut ground, fully in view with nothing covering it.
